beats: Mara tests the relay contacts and power feed.
The relay responds locally, ruling out the relay as the primary fault.
Mara changes position to inspect the cable entry and notices a recently disturbed floorboard.
Eli offers a practical reason to inspect the west span next.
Mara accepts the diagnostic logic, not an explanation for the floorboard.
They leave the shed for the west span.
